title: Sr. Full Stack Developer ( Night Shift)
description:
Job Description – Senior Full Stack Developer

**Experience:**
6 to 12 Years

**Location:**
Gandhinagar, Adalaj (On-site)

**Shift Timing:**
8:30 PM – 5:30 AM (Night Shift)

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced
**Senior Full Stack Developer**
with strong expertise in Angular and backend development. The role involves end-to-end development, along with direct client communication, requiring excellent English communication skills.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain scalable web applications using Angular and backend technologies.
* Design, develop, and integrate REST APIs and databases.
* Handle end-to-end development, debugging, and performance optimization.
* Communicate directly with international clients and understand technical requirements.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver projects efficiently.

Required Skills

* 7+ years of experience in Full Stack Development.
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **Angular (Mandatory)**
  .
* Proficiency in backend technologies such as .NET / Node.js / Java.
* Good knowledge of REST APIs, databases, and application architecture.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
* Strong client-handling and problem-solving abilities.
* Willingness to work in the night shift (8:30 PM – 5:30 AM) from the Gandhinagar office.

Interested candidates can share their updated resumes 8469774988 or connect with me directly.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer Role
description:
**About the Role:**

As a
**Senior Full Stack Engineer**
, you'll play a crucial role in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable and high-performance financial applications. You'll work across frontend, backend, and cloud technologies to deliver secure, reliable, and efficient software solutions.

**What We Offer:**

* Canteen Subsidy
* Night Shift allowance as per process
* Health Insurance
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Work-life balance initiatives
* Rewards & Recognition

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Build and optimize web and mobile applications using React and React Native.
* Develop backend services and APIs with GO.
* Work with AWS services, including Lambda, API Gateway, RDS-PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB.
* Implement payment processing features, ensuring security and compliance with industry standards.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and engineers to deliver robust software solutions.
* Write clean, maintainable code following software development best practices.
* Utilize GitHub, Bitbucket, and Jira for version control and project tracking.
* Ensure application performance, scalability, and security across multiple platforms.
* Participate in continuous code improvements and contribute to process enhancements alongside QA and product teams.

**What We Expect You to Have:**

* Five or more years of experience as a Full Stack Engineer or in a similar role.
* Strong proficiency in React, React Native, and GO.
* Hands-on experience with AWS services, including Lambda, API Gateway, RDS-PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB.
* Experience with RESTful API development and third-party API integrations.
* A passion for building secure, scalable, and high-performance applications.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a collaborative, team-first mindset.
* Excellent client communication skills.

**Role Description:**

The Senior Full Stack Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Gandhinagar, responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications that support Etech’s customer experience and AI analytics platforms. This role involves building robust back-end services and APIs, creating responsive front-end interfaces, and integrating systems to ensure secure, high-performing solutions. The engineer will collaborate closely with product managers, architects, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical designs, implement best practices in coding and testing, and participate in code reviews. Day-to-day activities include optimizing application performance, troubleshooting production issues, enhancing existing features, and contributing to technical documentation and architectural decisions. The Senior Full Stack Engineer will also mentor other engineers, promote engineering standards, and support continuous improvement across the development lifecycle.

**Qualifications
:**

* Strong proficiency in Full-Stack Development and Software Development, with experience delivering end-to-end web applications.
* Hands-on experience in Back-End Web Development, including building RESTful APIs and integrating with databases and external services.
* Proven skills in Front-End Development, using modern frameworks and libraries along with HTML and Cascading Style Sheets (CSS).
* Solid understanding of application architecture, design patterns, and secure coding practices.
* Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases, version control (e.g., Git), and CI/CD pipelines.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (such as AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerization technologies is beneficial.
* Ability to analyze complex problems, write clean and maintainable code, and work effectively in cross-functional teams.
* Relevant bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Prior experience in high-volume, data-driven, or enterprise environments, especially

title: Python Developer_4+ years
description:
We are looking for a skilled
 **Python Developer with hands\-on experience in GenAI, FastAPI, LangChain, and LangGraph** 
 to develop scalable and production\-ready AI applications.
   

  

 The candidate will work on
 **LLM\-based applications, RAG solutions, conversational AI, and agentic workflows** 
 , along with enterprise API and system integrations. The role requires strong backend development skills and the ability to independently deliver high\-quality solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design and develop scalable REST APIs using FastAPI.
* Develop GenAI and LLM\-powered applications using Python.
* Build LLM workflows and integrations using LangChain.
* Design and orchestrate AI agents and state\-driven workflows using LangGraph.
* Develop RAG\-based applications, including retrieval, embeddings, and prompt orchestration.
* Build conversational AI solutions such as chatbots and virtual assistants.
* Integrate AI applications with enterprise systems, databases, APIs, and knowledge bases.
* Work with Azure cloud services, including Azure OpenAI, App Services, and Functions.
* Optimize applications for performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
* Collaborate with backend, UI, DevOps, and other engineering teams.
* Follow best practices for coding, testing, version control, and production deployment.


 Mandatory Skills
   

  

* Strong hands\-on experience in Python development.
* Hands\-on experience with FastAPI and REST API development.
* Strong experience with LangChain for LLM orchestration.
* Hands\-on experience with LangGraph for agent orchestration and state\-based workflows.
* Experience developing GenAI / LLM\-based applications.
* Experience with RAG and prompt engineering.
* Good understanding of REST APIs and microservices architecture.
* Experience integrating APIs and backend services.
* Working knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases and Git.


 Good to Have
   

  

* Azure OpenAI and Azure cloud experience.
* Microsoft Agent Framework.
* Microsoft 365 Agents SDK.
* Conversational AI / chatbot development.
* Agentic AI workflows.
* Vector databases and embeddings.
* Docker/containerization.
* CI/CD and DevOps practices.


 Education
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in
 **Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering** 
 , or a related field.
   

  

 Skills: python,gen ai,llm,langchain,langgraph
